changelog: Fixes Personalized TV wall-clock/grid offsets on webOS without changing the already-working Next Unwatched, Random Unwatched or Resume selection logic. Concrete scheduled episodes still open as one isolated VOD item at 00:00, but the plugin now ignores Jellyfin server-generated automated progress for grid seeks and waits until the exact client PlaySessionId has reported at least two seconds of genuinely increasing playback. Only then is one wall-clock seek sent, with the target recalculated at that moment so the channel remains aligned to the Guide. The seek is never retried automatically; subsequent real client progress is used only to confirm that the target was reached. Loading remains 1.5 seconds, Standard TV and the existing UI are unchanged.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
